entity: Duffy for Wisconsin (Sean Duffy's old House committee): transfers to Northwoods Future PAC, which backs Michael Alfonso in WI-7
what_we_add: Raised $0 from donors; check dates 2025-10-27 and 2026-07-15; the $1M check is the biggest from any dormant campaign committee in 2025-26 (next: $215K)
why: WPR and Wigderson report $1.5M from Duffy's old account to Northwoods Future PAC, roughly half the PAC's money, with $2M+ spent for Alfonso; Badger Project had the first $1M in March. None has the $0-from-donors fact or the ranking against other dormant committees.
